notes.title: Dev. Update 1.11.17
notes.content:
Hello there, Alex here, from Vector7. We're glad to announce a new game update; 

Map updates:
- Fixed falling trought map point on level 14
- Fixed no damage outside the map on various levels
- Fixed elveator on level 1; you no longer can get stuck without an elevator on level 1.

Characters updates:
- Updated Bat Animation
- Added early Slime King model (level 16)

Achievement updates:
- Added a new set of free achievements unlockable when using the cheat for 100 life.


Thank you for the time, new levels are coming soon, so stay tuned!
